description: This file defines an abstract Projection class used for map projections, along with re-exports of specific projection implementations like LonLat, Mercator, and SphericalMercator. It provides documentation for methods projecting between geographical coordinates and 2D points.

classes.name: Projection
classes.description: An abstract class that provides methods to project geographical coordinates onto a flat surface and back. It includes properties for bounds and methods for projecting and unprojecting coordinates.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Projects geographical coordinates (LatLng) into a 2D point. Accepts only actual L.LatLng instances.

methods.name: unproject
methods.description: Converts a 2D point back into geographical coordinates. Accepts only actual L.Point instances.
